1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 6 m de altura, con flores de color blanquecino, fruto redondo y carnoso, con dos semillas; sus tallos se utilizaban para la construcción de garrochas. Bombacaceae Quararibea turbinata.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 6 m, with flowers of a whitish color, round and fleshy fruit containing two seeds; its stems were used for the construction of fishing spears. Bombacaceae Quararibea turbinata.
